description:
Kim Jae-Wun, a hapless man who has always been unlucky. Plagued by his usual bad luck on his birthday, he follows Yeong-yeong, seemingly possessed by the news that the CEO is looking for him. Without knowing why, he finds a handsome, young man sitting on his bed, too young to be a CEO. The man, who calls Jae-Wun "Yeouiju," squeezes his neck with an intangible force. Feeling the fear of death, Kim Jae-Wun instinctively begins to "reject" Sa Gi-Hwan. His violent grab is repelled by the Yeouiju's power. Humiliated, Sa Gi-Hwan attempts to harm Jae-Wun, but Yeong-yeong blocks his attempt.

A coming-of-age romance between Sa Gi-Hwan, an unnatural imoogi who treats Yeouiju Kim Jae-Wun like his property, and Yeong-yeong, a Yeouiju Kim Jae-Wun who strives to independently carve out a destiny predetermined for him.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
